    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddressConcerns" name="Address Concerns and Questions"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Collect_Join" name="Information Collected and Concerns Addressed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Interested_Split" name="Customer Interested?" default="Flow_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotInterested" name="Customer Not Interested"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Guide Product or Service Selection"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideQuote" name="Provide Quote"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendQuote" name="Send Quote to Customer" messageRef="Msg_Quote"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_QuoteApproved" name="Quote Approved by Customer">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_QuoteApproval" messageRef="Msg_QuoteApproval"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place Order"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record Order in System"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send Order Confirmation" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderConfirmed" name="Order Successfully Placed and Confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S1" sourceRef="Start_Inquiry" targetRef="Gateway_Collect_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S2a" sourceRef="Gateway_Collect_Split" targetRef="Task_CollectInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S2b" sourceRef="Gateway_Collect_Split" targetRef="Task_AddressConcerns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S3a" sourceRef="Task_CollectInfo" targetRef="Gateway_Collect_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S3b" sourceRef="Task_AddressConcerns" targetRef="Gateway_Collect_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S3" sourceRef="Gateway_Collect_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Interested_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interested" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested_Split" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${customerInterested == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInterested" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested_Split" targetRef="End_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S4" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_ProvideQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S5" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Task_SendQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S6" sourceRef="Task_SendQuote" targetRef="Event_QuoteApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S7" sourceRef="Event_QuoteApproved" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S8" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S9" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S10" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="End_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
